title: Book 30 minutes with the person who can actually answer
body: Not a discovery call with an SDR reading a script. You get someone who would actually own the work, whichever part of it your question is about, and a straight answer on whether we are the right fit.
agenda: Where the data sits today and what is blocking the use cases you want
What is realistically achievable on Snowflake, and in what order
A rough shape and range, or an honest no if the fit is wrong
reassure: No deck, no obligation, and no follow-up sequence you have to unsubscribe from.

meta.who: Technical people, not a sales desk

ctaAria: Pick a time to talk to the team (opens the scheduler)
facesLabel: The people who answer for the work
